text.short: Bakersfield, 1954. The Maitia family's dining room behind a cocktail lounge on East 19th.
text.today: Three generations of one family have run it: J.B. and Mayie Maitia opened in 1954, their daughter Jenny took it on, and Jenny's daughter Christiane works it now. The bar takes walk-ins; a table is a phone call ahead.
text.table: A relish tray lands first — pickled tongue, salsa, beans, bread — and keeps landing. The entree is what you ordered; the rest of the meal is not.

x_kitchen.says: Basque, in the sheepherder line, with a French Basque hand

seating.note: The house site puts it plainly: tables by reservation, walk-ins at the counter. Two people get their own table if they call.

prices.includes: the relish tray, soup, beans and bread that arrive with every dinner
